This is a message from Volunteer Energy Cooperative.
A planned power outage is scheduled for your area on Friday, October 30, beginning at 8:30 AM. Some members are expected to have power restored at approximately 12:00 PM, while others may remain without power until approximately 3:30 PM.
Members whose power remains off for the full outage on Thursday may also experience intermittent outages on Friday as crews continue replacing poles in the area. All work is expected to be completed by approximately 3:30 PM each day.
This work is necessary to safely replace poles along a double-circuit power line.
We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience as we complete these necessary upgrades.
